requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement contains concern-mixing (functional action + quality criterion). Decomposed into one functional requirement (inform security service) and one quality requirement (response time ≤ 2 seconds) per Pohl §25.2.

source_fragments: the system shall inform the security service

fields.condition: the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged

structured_requirements.final_statement: When the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged, the system shall inform the security service.
structuring_notes: Extracted functional action from concern-mixed requirement. Response time constraint moved to separate quality requirement.

structured_requirements.final_statement: The security service notification shall be sent within 2 seconds after damage detection.
structuring_notes: Extracted quality criterion (response time) as a separate artefact per Pohl §25.2.
